status: frozen experiment r1 before adapter implementation
authority: private implementation experiment; not a binding specification

content.retrievalUri: optional absolute retrieval identity, never permission to fetch

source.resources: Application supplies immutable ResourceInput values; cold reload re-supplies resources at the same absolute URIs. The OBI is not claimed to embed the whole reference graph.

binding.method: lowercase OAS method key, initially get/post qualified

request.cardinality: exactly one object value then input close; no request until close; zero or second values refuse before effects

members.parameters: optional object with optional path/query objects; supplied values are string/number/boolean scalars
members.body: optional exact JSON value; absent means no entity, null means JSON null

request.unknownMembers: refuse before effects; never silently discard misspellings or undeclared parameters

response.complete2xxJson: one exact decoded body followed by successful terminal
response.complete204: no value followed by successful terminal; must actually have no content
response.completeNon2xx: failed terminal local.openapi-json-probe.r1.http-status, application data exactly {status:<integer>}; no output and no body JSON-validity claim
response.effects: No ERR_REFUSED or CONTEXT_REQUIRED after operation effects may have begun; cancellation does not promise rollback

context.value: exact literal URL selecting an effective declared server; not arbitrary override
context.multipleServers: missing/wrong type/out-of-set value returns config.value challenge with point above, path empty and string enum of permitted values
context.attempt: caller explicitly starts a new attempt; no automatic retries or context persistence

synthesis.sources: zero gives skeleton; one preserved verbatim; more than one is unsupported composition
synthesis.keys: provider-generated unique keys are suggestions and not operation identity
synthesis.schemas: derive only mechanical request-envelope structure, parameter names/scalar types and required flags; omit output schemas; report source-schema fidelity as lossy without claiming general schema translation
synthesis.inventory: known unsupported target distinct from unestablished remainder; source-local identity shared with inspector

admissionProfile.positiveEdition: Qualify 3.1.2; admit the 3.1 patch family according to client edition interpretation. No old patch allowlist.
admissionProfile.parameters: path/query scalar declarations with supported default/simple/form serialization; no schema evaluator is implied
admissionProfile.media: finite application/json request/response or declared no-content response
admissionProfile.servers: absolute HTTP(S), unique URL membership, no variable expansion in first slice
admissionProfile.security: no nonempty security requirements; richer declarations are implementation-unsupported
admissionProfile.references: supplied named resources only; mounted path identity independent of each resource reference base
admissionProfile.unsupported: forms/binary/streaming/extra request locations/schema translation/callback service/webhooks/ambiguous path-item merges; report, do not silently erase

provenance: chosen H01-H08; no old draft input
